names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Ιωάννης, Μωυσής, Αντίοχος και Αντωνίνος», with the rank words left off. The life page heads him «Αγιος Μωυσης» alone. Two other men of this name stand on saint.gr's same day, one a disciple of Polychronius and one out of Russia, on pages of their own.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 23 февраля ст. ст., «Моисей Сирийский, пустынник», with the rank word left off. The line names two men Moses — «Моисея» in fourth place and «Моисея другого», the other Moses, in seventh — and the calendar prints one name link for them both; this is the fourth-place Moses, the one its life sets beside John and near the village of Ramas. The other Moses of the same line is kept here as a separate folder, as the calendar keeps him as a separate entry.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 февраля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Иоанна, Антиоха, Антонина, Моисея, Зевина, Полихрония, Моисея другого и Дамиана, пустынников Сирийских (V).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Ιωάννης, Μωυσής, Αντίοχος και Αντωνίνος»

attestations.note: One page for the four of them. It makes John a disciple of Limnaeus, kept on 22 February, and puts his ascesis on a mountain near the city of Targala; the other three imitated him and passed their lives on the high peak of the mountain of the city of Ramas. It gives no year for any of them and prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(V)» after the eight names for 23 февраля ст. ст., and its life closes «Все эти преподобные отцы мирно скончались в V в. в Сирии».
